label: {name}. {hint}
help: Hold K to pinch. E takes an idea within reach, Q sets the top one down as a step. A step left behind when you leave a room is lost for the night.

words.ladder_sign: you don't know this story yet

rooms.name: The gap
rooms.hint: An idea lies behind you: pinch, step up to it, E. Asleep, the current carries you over the gap. Pinch over the far floor to land; stand pinched in the exit to go on.

rooms.name: The soft wall
rooms.hint: Drift through the soft wall. Pinch on the far side, one jump up to the exit; stand pinched in it to go on.

rooms.name: The goat
rooms.hint: Wait for the goat and let it carry you over. Pinch above the far floor; stand pinched in the exit to go on.

rooms.name: The climb
rooms.hint: Pinch and climb; asleep the wind takes you off the ledges. The top is one step too high: Q sets an idea down to stand on. A step you leave behind is lost for the night.

rooms.name: The maze
rooms.hint: Drift into the current and let it lift you through the soft walls. Pinch over the island, not before; the exit is at its far end.

rooms.name: Cold water
rooms.hint: The water takes you if you pinch over it. Ride the goat round; pinch above the beam on its way back, then down to the far floor.

rooms.name: The draft
rooms.hint: Drift right and the draft takes you up through the soft room. Pinch over the shelf on the way up, not before: the idea is there. The way on is the perch above it: ride the draft to the top and pinch over the perch, or Q a step down and jump.

rooms.name: The ladder
rooms.hint: It goes up to somewhere you have not been. Not tonight. Stand pinched in the exit to go on.

rooms.name: Your bed
rooms.hint: E at your bed wakes you gently with everything under your hat. When the bed comes early, the exit past it is the bet: the night goes on, and the frame with it.
